learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Understand the data analysis concepts and primary methods (Time Series Analysis, Classification, Regression, Clustering, Association Rules….)
Understand basic process in data analytics
Understand how to clean, and organize data for analysis, evaluate, and complete analysis and calculations using spreadsheets, SQL, R programming or Python
Design database schemas based on the conceptual model by using appropriate tools (spreadsheets, SQL, R programming, Tableau or Python)
Visualize and present data findings in dashboards, presentations and commonly used visualization platforms
